submitted.rationale: At 2.06 eV, BiVO4 (~2.4 eV gap) barely absorbs, so I focused on copper vanadates, which have smaller band gaps (~1.8–2.0 eV). I measured three points along the Cu:V axis, keeping Bi low (~8%). The best was index 84 (Cu:V ≈ 1.5, close to Cu3V2O8) at 2.6e-7 A. The Cu:V ≈ 0.87 composition (index 0) gave 6e-8 A and the more Cu-rich Cu:V ≈ 2.3 composition (index 101) gave 1.3e-7 A, which points to a peak near Cu3V2O8 stoichiometry.

rejected.reason: Measured 6e-8 A. This V-richer composition (Cu:V ~0.87) gave the lowest photocurrent.
Measured 1.3e-7 A. Going more Cu-rich (Cu:V ~2.3) roughly halved the photocurrent compared with index 84.
BiVO4's band gap (~2.4 eV) is above the 2.06 eV photon energy, so it should absorb little. Not measured.
